classification_note: The grouping of optional software-developer skills is a descriptive taxonomy, not a ranking by vacancy frequency, specialization level, or future outlook.

dimensions.label: Mention frequency in vacancies
dimensions.unit: share of relevant vacancy texts mentioning the skill
dimensions.source_title: CBS, Skills vraag en aanbod in online vacatures, eerste en tweede kwartaal 2026
dimensions.limitation: CBS publishes experimental vacancy-skill statistics by occupation, education level, and province using CompetentNL V2. The named ESCO language and product concepts in this pilot have not yet been mapped and counted against that series.

dimensions.label: Skill type / specialization context
dimensions.limitation: These groups describe the kind of capability, not how niche it is or how often employers request it.

dimensions.label: Future outlook
dimensions.limitation: UWV reports occupation-level labour-market trends; no future-demand score is inferred for any named programming language or tool.
